whenToUse: Forum, community or Q&A topic lists with replies, views and the latest post.
A "latest discussions" module on a home page or in a sidebar (TopicRow in your own list).
avoidWhen: Threaded replies inside one topic — use comment-thread.
Editorial articles — use post-card or blog-list.
Sortable admin tables of posts — use data-table.
a11y: A named list; each row's title is a heading whose link covers the row, while category and tag links stay their own tab stops.
Column heads are aria-hidden; every cell carries its own words ("23 replies", "Last post by …"), and pinned / locked / solved are spoken, not only shown as icons.
